title: Question
description: A structured question awaiting an answer (questions profile). The ask_user mechanism that raises one is Core; this persisted object + the answer UX are the questions profile. Normative.

format.description: Answer shape (questions profile; optional, absent ⇒ text). text = free-form; single_select = exactly one option value; multi_select = zero-or-more option values (array answer).

label.description: Optional human-facing display text; defaults to value.

anyOf.description: Typed options: each carries a stable value and an optional display label.

options.description: Optional closed answer set; null/absent ⇒ free-form. Either bare value strings or typed {value,label?} objects.

allow_other.description: When true and options are present, an answer MAY carry a free-form value outside the option set. Absent ⇒ false.

answer.description: The submitted answer: a single value (text/single_select) or an array of selected values (multi_select); null ⇒ unanswered. Set-membership in options (when present) is enforced at answer time (Questions.md §3), not by this schema.

suggested.description: The agent's best-guess answer, if any.
